PaperReview.title: PaperReview
PaperReview.description: A structured critical appraisal and peer-review dossier with 6-axis rubric scores/justifications, separated scientific/extraction confidence, appraisal mode, provenance disclosure, and source-anchored evidence findings.

title.description: Title of the reviewed academic manuscript

venueOrCitation.description: Journal, conference venue, DOI, or full citation string

isEmpirical.description: Whether the paper contains empirical data/experiments

credibilityScore.description: Authoritative weighted 6-axis composite credibility score from 0 to 100

mathRigorScore.description: Mathematical and statistical rigor rubric score (0-10)

mathRigorJustification.description: Full untruncated quantitative and statistical rubric justification

extractionConfidence.description: Document extraction and source grounding confidence score (1-5)

coverageDisclosure.description: Transparent page extraction, omission, and visual routing provenance summary

validationStatus.description: Pipeline grounding and adjudication validation state

structuredFindingsJson.description: Serialized JSON array of source-anchored ReviewFinding evidence ledger items

abstractSummary.description: Stage 00b clean summary of the manuscript abstract and central thesis

researchQuestion.description: Primary research question and identification strategy

keyMethodology.description: Summary of core empirical or theoretical methodology

blueTeamVerification.description: Stage 02-03 Blue Team defense, numerical verification, and surviving issues

mathAuditReport.description: Stage 01e-01fd quantitative, statistical, and derivation audit

codeAuditReport.description: Stage 01i-01n reproducibility, provenance, and clinical applicability audit

editorNote.description: Stage 08b Editor synthesis note and decision rationale

copyeditSuggestions.description: Stage 09c author-facing copyediting, clarity, and structural improvements

reviewerQuestions.description: Anticipated Reviewer 2 questions and suggested defenses

bookmarked.description: Whether the user has starred/bookmarked this review

personalNotes.description: User's private referee or reading notes on the manuscript

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the review was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp())

/users/{userId}/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Per-user subcollection of critical journal paper reviews and source-anchored appraisal dossiers.
